notes: CBER letter for CharaExo (amniotic-fluid product), CharaCore, and CharaOmni (umbilical-cord-derived products): unapproved new drug/unlicensed biological product violations (products fail HCT/P minimal-manipulation and homologous-use criteria and are promoted for disease treatment), plus CGMP quality-unit failures (21 CFR 211.22) and a CGTP donor-eligibility documentation failure (21 CFR 1271.55(d)(1)(iii)), and a misbranding finding limited to CharaExo (expiration dates extended without supporting data, 502(a)). No FEI or organisms are stated in the letter.
